messages:
maya: FYI we're seeing sustained packet loss to eu-central3 GPU fabric from two upstream peers, ~30% p50 p95 RTT spikes. autoscaler is thrashing, several pods OOM/killed. shifting routing now.

sam: copy. any customer-facing impact observed yet?

maya: several customers on hosted tier show increased errors for large-context models (timeout 504s). latency SLOs breached for ~15% of requests.

leo: opened Support bridge, pinged top 12 affected accounts. drafting a short status note.

irene: can you paste the exact status page blurb? I'll push once we agree. need ETA.

maya: plan: 1) apply traffic split to route ~30% of new sessions to eu-west1 cold pool; 2) fallback to smaller model family (redwood-medium) for in-flight requests that exceed 8k tokens; 3) restart autoscaler with conservative thresholds. doing step 1 now.

deploy-bot: routing-policy update applied: region_split(eu-central3->eu-west1)=30% by maya at 1799954520

sam: logs:
```
autoscaler: scale_down_delay_exceeded
kubelet: eviction eviction_reason=memory.available
net: peer-a tcp retransmits high
```

maya: exact error snippets match that. taking autoscaler out of aggressive mode: setting `scaleDownDelay=300`, `maxSurge=2`. will monitor.

irene: status page draft: "We are investigating elevated errors and latency for eu-central3. Traffic is being shifted to a healthy region and mitigations are in progress. We expect progressive recovery in ~45 minutes. Updates will follow." okay to post?

leo: posted to status page as incident-rc: eu-central3 - degraded GPU fabric and routing, customers notified via support. Also sent initial emails to affected enterprise contacts.

harry: costs check — moving 30% to eu-west1 cold pool + using burst capacity will increase hour spend ~+28% for the affected traffic window. approve?

sam: given customer impact, approve temporary cost. prefer we set a budget guardrail and re-evaluate at +1h.

harry: approved, set budget tag `inc-1799954321` and alert on spend > +40% expected.

maya: autoscaler restart done at 1799955320, traffic split stable, p50 latency improving. p95 still elevated. working on KV cache warmups in eu-west1 to lower tail.

deploy-bot: fallback-policy applied: model_fallback=redwood-medium for long-context sessions at 1799956120

status-bot: status update posted to status.redwood.ai: "Partial mitigation in place; routing shifted and model fallbacks active. Customers with persistent errors should open support tickets; enterprise contacts notified."

leo: support bridge note -> "If a customer reports rate or timeout errors, set `prefer_region=eu-west1` or downgrade to `model=redwood-medium` as temporary workaround. cc @oncall-sre"

maya: monitoring shows error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% over last 10m after split. still keeping watch. will update again in 20m or earlier if anything changes.

sam: good progress. capture postmortem footprint: cause=upstream peering instability, mitigations=routing split, autoscaler tuning, model fallback, cost=+28% window. assign to maya+neteng.

maya: assigning now, will start timeline and put notes into incident doc.

harry: thanks all. once we have stable metrics for 30m, plan to revert split to 0% and scale back burst.

maya: noted. final update planned in ~30m. :white_check_mark:
